subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial evidence intake, bridge letter & delegation templates
messages:
From: Alice Jensen <alice@brightpathhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Redwood SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter for integration review

Hi Laura,

Quick intro — I'm Alice from BrightPath Health's security team. We're running a third-party risk review ahead of our production integration and need your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (covering Redwoods' hosted API) and a bridge letter if the report period doesn't cover our upcoming go-live. Our audit window requirement is broadly aligned with calendar H2 2027; please confirm the period you can provide.

Deliverables that would be helpful:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- Bridge letter (if latest report coverage ends before our required date)
- Evidence mapping or list of representative artifacts (log retention, change mgmt, backup, incident response)
- Preferred secure transfer method (S3 presigned, secure SharePoint link, or DocuSign for contract items)

We're trying to complete vendor risk by 2028-04-15. Can you confirm what you'll be able to share and by when?

Thanks,
Alice Jensen
Security Engineer, BrightPath Health
[Attachment: vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jensen <alice@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter for integration review

Hi Alice — thanks for the request and timeline. Overview and commitments below.

What we can provide today:
- SOC 2 Type II report (period 2027-01-01 through 2027-12-31) — PDF of the final report.
- Bridge letter confirming controls remained in place from 2028-01-01 through 2028-03-31, with known changes documented.
- Evidence mapping CSV that lists representative artifacts by control family (logs, change tickets, backup configs, access reviews).

Audit period notes: our last Type II covers the 2027 calendar year. If you need coverage into H1 2028, the bridge letter will explicitly state control continuity through 2028-03-31. If your requirement extends beyond 2028-03-31, let us know ASAP and well escalate procurement for an exception or alternate mitigation.

Secure transfer options (pick one):
1) S3 presigned URL (preferred for bulk artifacts) — we will upload zipped artifacts with short-lived presigned links.
2) Encrypted SharePoint/Drive folder (for smaller packages).
3) Approved secure portal via our SOC vendor (can be slower).

Attached: a short bridge-letter template, sample evidence-mapping CSV, and transfer instructions.

Next steps: please confirm (a) whether the bridge letter through 2028-03-31 is sufficient, and (b) which transfer option you prefer. If you want a minimal set of artifacts (instead of full mappings), indicate priority control families (e.g., CC6 - change control, CC7 - config/asset mgmt, CC9 - logical access).

One-line reply templates you can use for faster approvals (copy/paste):
- "Bridge letter through 2028-03-31 is acceptable; please send presigned S3 links."
- "Need coverage through 2028-06-30; please confirm whether additional artifacts or a formal exception will be provided."

Thanks — ccing Karthik (security ops) to coordinate the artifact package.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Trust & Compliance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_bridge_letter_template.docx (docx)]

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-01T10:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II — initial evidence intake, bridge letter & delegation templates

Team — forwarding BrightPath's ask. TL;DR: they want the Type II + bridge letter and an evidence mapping. Deadline target 2028-04-15.

Action items:
- Karthik: can you assemble the representative artifact list for CC6/CC7/CC9 and produce the CSV? Include sample logs (redacted), change ticket crosswalk, and backup config snap. Aim EOD 2028-04-02.
- Mina: please prepare the presigned S3 upload instructions and generate 7-day presigned links. We'll use a single zipped package. Include a README listing filenames and minimal redaction notes.

Attachments to send to customer: SOC2-2027-final.pdf, redwood_bridge_letter_template.docx (filled), evidence_mapping_sample.csv (filled), README.txt with transfer instructions. Avoid sending raw PII — redact account IDs and user emails where possible.

I'll draft the bridge letter using the template and attach it to the package. If BrightPath pushes for coverage beyond 2028-03-31, escalate to procurement (I'll handle).

Thanks — please confirm ownership on the items above.

Laura

From: Alice Jensen <alice@brightpathhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-03T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — initial evidence intake, bridge letter & delegation templates

Laura,

Thanks — bridge letter through 2028-03-31 is sufficient for our initial review. We prefer the S3 presigned link approach for artifacts.

We'll accept a representative artifact set focused on the following control families: CC6 (change mgmt), CC7 (config and asset mgmt), CC9 (logical access), and CC10 (incident response). If you can include a redacted sample log (one week), a change ticket export for two recent releases, and your automated backup configuration snapshot, that should be enough for our security review team.

Please send presigned links and the filled bridge letter by 2028-04-08 to keep our review on schedule. One-line confirmation: "Presigned S3 upload + bridge letter to 2028-03-31 — we'll deliver by 2028-04-08."

Appreciate the quick turn.

Regards,
Alice Jensen
BrightPath Health — Security Team
[Attachment: vendor_questionnaire_filled.xlsx (xlsx)]
